meta.name: orchestrator-loop
meta.description: Orchestration pipeline for development tasks. The orchestrator delegates everything and never writes code directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编排开发任务流水线，自动分配工作给子agent
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动协调多个开发子任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate development task pipelines, automatically delegating work to subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically coordinate multiple development subtasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个项目协调员，负责把开发任务拆解成调研、计划、执行、检查、报告五个步骤，并调用其他子技能或工具来完成每一步，自己绝不直接写代码。
howto.when: 当你提出一个开发任务（如修改代码、添加功能）时触发。如果任务简单（单文件、改动少于20行、低风险、指令明确），会走快捷流程；否则走完整五步流程。

say.text: 帮我重构这个模块，先调研再计划。
把这个函数改成异步，改动很小。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a project coordinator that breaks down development tasks into five steps: research, plan, implement, review, and report. It delegates each step to other sub-skills or tools and never writes code directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a development task (e.g., modify code, add feature). For simple tasks (single file, <20 lines, low risk, clear instructions), it uses a shortcut flow; otherwise, it follows the full five-step pipeline.

say_en.text: Refactor this module, start with research and plan.
Make this function async, it's a small change.
